mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in housing starts (HOUST below 680.0) and industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals a dual deterioration in consumer demand and manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 50.0 in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates a recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 400,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where RSAFS < 400000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
